results.name: Complete one skill without setup
results.expected: Six 4/6 cycles; visible finish within 90 seconds; one saved completed record.

observed.assumptions: No required typing, no voluntary pauses or support visits; includes UI scheduling delay.

results.name: Pause during exhale and stop
results.expected: Pause preserves count; resume works; stopping saves a stopped record.

observed.outcome:

Stopped.

4.4 seconds · 0 / 6 cycles

Saved on this computer.

Back to breathing
View history

results.name: Support interrupts exercise
results.expected: Support opens independently, pauses exercise, returns paused, and allows stopping.
results.observed: Support paused; Return did not resume; Stop exercise exited.

results.name: Backend outage and session retry
results.expected: Exercise and support work without API; failed save is honest; retry saves one row.

results.name: Failed chat request, support and retry
results.expected: Support survives request failure; same request retries once without duplicate messages.

results.name: Refresh unfinished exercise
results.expected: Return home with no fabricated completed or stopped record; limitation disclosed.

observed.decision: Explicit Stop/finish records only; unfinished refresh is disclosed and unsaved.

results.name: Preferences restore and reset
results.expected: Explicit mode/text choices persist across reload and can reset without blocking Start.
results.observed: Motion/larger restored; reset gave still-text pacing and retained immediate Start.

results.name: Narrow layout
results.expected: Home, chat, history, support and exercise remain within a 320px viewport.

results.name: Reduced motion preference
results.expected: Browser reduced-motion setting overrides a saved moving-circle default on entry.
results.observed: Chromium emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce selected text pacing; not an OS settings-panel test.

results.name: Keyboard controls and dialog focus
results.expected: Keyboard activates Pause/Resume; Escape closes support and restores focus.
results.observed: Enter paused/resumed/stopped; Escape restored support-button focus. Screen-reader speech not evaluated.

results.name: Session history pagination matches API
results.expected: Older/Newer pages show distinct saved IDs in API order.

results.name: Long chat shows newest reply after send
results.expected: Sending from the first page reveals the new reply; earlier messages remain accessible.

results.name: Fictional crisis-related input
results.expected: Mock redirects to independent support without claiming monitoring or therapy.
results.observed: This coursework app cannot provide crisis care. Open Crisis support for external help. No one monitors this app.

results.name: Out-of-scope diagnosis request
results.expected: Mock explains scope; exercise remains available and unchanged.
results.observed: This demo covers the breathing exercise and saved activity. It cannot assess feelings, diagnose, or provide therapy.

results.name: Background-tab interruption
results.expected: Real tab visibility change pauses exercise; returning requires explicit Resume.
results.observed: Error: INCONCLUSIVE: browser automation did not actually hide the page; native tab switching remains unverified. No synthetic event counted as evidence.

results.name: Text spacing override
results.expected: Increased line/letter/word spacing leaves controls usable without page overflow.

results.name: Unknown pause history uses fixed reply
results.expected: Past pause history is explicitly unknown; fixed guidance is labeled and saved with no invented citations.

observed.content: Saved session records do not include pause events, so this app cannot tell whether a past session was paused. Completion and active duration do not establish an uninterrupted session.

results.name: Model request pending while leaving chat
results.expected: An unresolved model request does not block starting/stopping the exercise or opening support.
